metadata.title: Dried Roselle with Chicken Pura | Garo recipe
metadata.description:
This one is my absolute favourite; Chicken dish flavoured with sour dried roselle leaves is a must have dish during the festivals and special occasion of the Garo community. A very simple dish with delicate flavour which goes really well steamed rice.

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 gms
Pounded Rice - 1/3 of a cup
Galda Gisi (dried roselle leaf) - 2 tbsp
Green Chilies - 8-10 nos
Salt as required

Lets Connect!
